thread:
alice_support: Hi team — customer Janeway reports their app started returning 401s this morning after a refund was processed. They say their trial credits went to 0 and account now shows a negative balance.
customer_janeway: confirming — I submitted a refund request yesterday, got the email that it completed, and now API calls fail with 401 / 402s. We had ~$120 in trial credits.
alice_support: thanks. Can you paste the exact error body (redact keys) and the account id?
customer_janeway: account = acct_01G7X, error: `{ "error": "unauthorized", "code": 401, "message": "insufficient credits" }` — weird to be 401 but msg says credits.
alice_support: noted. I opened an internal ticket and pinging billing. @ben_billing — can you check if the refund flow triggered a credit clawback or reversed promo grants? Ticket S-3412.
ben_billing: looking. Refund id R-9927 links to chargeback processed 2024-12-11. Our ledger shows the promo trial grant was flagged and reversed as part of the refund reversal policy — system debited $120 from promo balance and applied a chargeback, leaving a -$45 balance after prorated usage.
ben_billing: reason: we have an automated rollback that revokes trial/promo credits when a chargeback/ATS reversal completes. It usually creates a ledger entry `promo_revocation`.
mika_engineer: copying logs for the API error path — the auth service treats `effective_balance <= 0` as auth-failure for free-tier tokens to prevent usage while in debt. That generates a 401 with message referencing credits.
alice_support: ah ok, so two pieces: billing revoked promo credits after refund, and edge auth rule denies calls when account negative. That explains 401s.
customer_janeway: is there a path to restore my trial credits while we sort the refund? The chargeback is still disputed on my end. Right now the product is unusable.
ben_billing: policy note: if a chargeback is disputed and pending, we can put a manual hold instead of automatic clawback. For this case, the refund already settled via the processor, so the auto-revocation ran. But we can do a manual credit adjustment while dispute continues.
mika_engineer: for immediate unblock we can flip a feature-flag to allow API access while finance reviews, but that's a little risky. Safer is to add a one-off credit grant and remove the negative ledger entry once resolved.
alice_support: proposed remediation steps: 1) grant one-off account credit of $150 to unblock. 2) create internal ops task to re-evaluate the `promo_revocation` timing so it doesn't run until chargeback final. 3) add clearer error mapping so client sees `402 Payment Required` instead of 401.
ben_billing: I can do step 1 now. Applying `manual_credit:+150` to acct_01G7X. I logged entry: BILL-ADJ-7845.
ops-bot: Applied credit adjustment. New balances: promo: 0, paid_balance: 105.00, effective_balance: 105.00.
customer_janeway: I can confirm API calls succeeding again, thank you! :raised_hands:
alice_support: great. Follow-ups: ben — please attach refund/chargeback docs to S-3412 and coordinate with payments team to check processor timeline. Mika — can you file a small task to change error codes and to gate promo_revocation on processor finality?
ben_billing: will do. I put payment gateway transaction IDs and dispute timeline in the ticket. Also proposing a short-term change: run `promo_revocation` asynchronously with a 24h delay to catch quick reversals.
mika_engineer: filing ENG-5620 for the error code mapping + gating logic.
alice_support: Thanks everyone. customer_janeway — I'll keep the ticket open and update as we get closure. If dispute resolves in our favor we will keep the manual credit and reconcile ledger; if not we'll invoice/collect per finance guidance but we'll notify you in advance.
customer_janeway: appreciate it. will follow up with my payments team and share dispute reference.
alice_support: thread closed for now — reopening on updates. :white_check_mark:
